g.text: CoreGene Bayes Benchmark | Synthetic calibration audit

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: Reliability points: ten probability bins; marker size reflects count. Bins are descriptive; within-dataset genes are dependent.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: Coverage: dots and bars = observed coverage and Wilson 95% interval; vertical ticks = actual mean posterior set mass. No biological validation.
